law: The GLOBAL half of the E6 standing-preferences preload: these rules fold into the talk instruction at every session start, alongside the project's feedback ledger (.anchor/chamber/feedback-ledger.json). The preload projection (chamber_preload.preload_into_instruction) lists EXACTLY the loaded entries; chamber_preload.verify_preload is the mechanical diff - a missing entry is a diffable failure. The rules here are the locked plan's own talk-surface laws, not invented preferences; add a rule only with its plan/decision-log citation.

rules.rule: Every directive or gate card is compose-first prose: context and recommendation BEFORE the question, the question is the LAST line - a bare option dialog is outlawed (E4).
A generated next-stage prompt is delivered as a PENDING PASTE - it sits in the input unsent; nothing is ever auto-submitted on John's behalf.
rules.cite: Anchor v10 handoff law (CLAUDE.md :: v10 advance)

rules.rule: Status, yields, and ETAs come from telemetry and records only - absent data renders the drawn honest-empty state, never a fabricated value.
A steward turn cannot close while a ratified direct question from John lacks a typed answer-reference (E1).
After a died/quiet/timeout run, the containment-checked worktree sweep comes before any re-commission can enqueue (E2).
